name: planning-with-files
title_zh: 任务拆解写到磁盘，/clear 后自动续上进度
tagline_zh: 把计划写成 Markdown 文件常驻磁盘：崩溃、/clear、上下文压缩都不丢进度，随时从断点接着施工。
tagline_en: Plans live as Markdown on disk — surviving crashes, /clear and compaction; work resumes from the exact checkpoint every time.
desc_en: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.
why_zh: 长任务的命根子是「状态不丢」，它用最朴素的文件方案解决，比花哨的记忆系统皮实。
why_en: Long tasks live or die on durable state; plain files beat fancy memory systems for robustness.
limit_zh: 装法决定功能：npx skills add 装的没有 /plan-goal 和 /plan-loop。「没做完不许停」的门也只在 Claude Code、Codex CLI 真拦得住，OpenCode、Gemini CLI 只弹提示。
limit_en: The install route decides what you get: `npx skills add` ships no /plan-goal or /plan-loop; only the plugin route does. The completion gate hard-blocks on Claude Code, Codex CLI and Continue.dev; OpenCode and Gemini CLI just get a notice.
